section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch1 — Principles of Development
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Despite facing significant poverty and family instability, a student manages to remain academically motivated, forms healthy relationships, and adapts well to challenges — with the support of at least one caring adult in their life. This capacity to adapt positively despite adversity is called:
explanation: Resilience is the capacity to adapt positively despite significant adversity — a stable, caring relationship with an adult is one of the strongest protective factors supporting it.
